Complaint_Use_Case: I have a large jack tree in my backyard that is leaning towards the roof. How do I get a permit to cut it down?
Official_Rules: # Official Service Rules: Permit to Cut a Protected Tree (Agriculture) **Service Name**: Permit to Cut a Protected Tree **Service ID**: tree_cutting_permit **Category**: Agriculture & Environment **Office Type**: Divisional Secretariat (Agrarian Services / Environment branch) **Official Fee**: 100 LKR ## Description Under Sri Lankan law, certain trees (including Jack/Kos, Breadfruit/Del, and Palmyrah) are protected. Citizens must obtain a formal permit before cutting them down, even on private property. ## Required Documents 1. **Application Form**: Available at the Grama Niladhari (GN) office. 2. **Proof of Ownership**: Original land deed and a certified copy. 3. **GN Recommendation**: GN must inspect the tree (checking if it risks buildings like roofs) and sign the recommendation. 4. **Photographs**: Visual proof of the tree's position relative to the house/roof. | # Official Service Rules: National Identity Card (NIC) Renewal **Service Name**: National Identity Card (NIC) Renewal **Service ID**: nic_renewal **Category**: Personal Identification **Office Type**: Divisional Secretariat (Department of Registration of Persons branch) **Official Fee**: 500 LKR **Official Processing Time**: 14 Days ## Description This service allows Sri Lankan citizens to renew their National Identity Card (NIC) due to expiration, damage, or changes in personal details. ## Required Official Documents 1. **Application Form (Annexure 1)**: Duly filled application form certified by the Grama Niladhari. 2. **Current/Old NIC**: The original card to be handed over (or a police report if lost). 3. **Original Birth Certificate**: Must be submitted along with a copy. 4. **Photographs**: Three (3) color photographs of size 1.3" x 1.8", certified on the reverse side by the Grama Niladhari. 5. **Marriage Certificate**: Required only if name has changed due to marriage (original and photocopy). | # Official Service Rules: Land Deed Title Transfer (Property) **Service Name**: Land Deed Title Transfer **Service ID**: land_deed_transfer **Category**: Property & Land Registry **Office Type**: Land Registry (Divisional Secretariat region) **Official Fee**: Stamp duty (varies based on property valuation) + Registration fee (1,000 LKR). ## Description Transfer of land ownership between family members or buyers. ## Step-by-Step Title Transfer Process 1. **Title Search**: Must perform a title search at the local Land Registry to verify ownership and check for encumbrances. 2. **Drafting of Deed**: A licensed Notary Public must draft the transfer deed. 3. **Valuation & Stamp Duty**: Pay stamp duty at a state bank based on the land value. 4. **Execution**: The transferor (e.g. grandmother) and transferee (grandson) must sign the deed before the Notary Public and two witnesses. 5. **Registration**: Submit the executed deed to the Land Registry for registration and update of the title index.

Complaint_Use_Case: I am starting a small software consulting business from home. Do I need to register it at the Pradeshiya Sabha or the Divisional Secretariat?
Official_Rules: # Official Service Rules: Local Business Registration (Commerce) **Service Name**: Local Business Registration **Service ID**: business_registration **Category**: Commerce & Trade **Office Type**: Divisional Secretariat (Business Registration branch) **Official Fee**: 2,500 LKR (Sole Proprietorship) ## Description Registration of a sole proprietorship, partnership, or business name. Small home-based businesses (like software consulting) must register at the **Divisional Secretariat** of their business address, not at the Pradeshiya Sabha (which only handles municipal trade licenses/rates). ## Required Documents 1. **Business Registration Form (Form A)**: Duly filled application. 2. **GN Certificate**: Resident/location approval signed by the Grama Niladhari. 3. **Deed / Lease Agreement**: Proof of the home/office property ownership or lease. 4. **NIC Copy**: Owner's identity card. | # Official Service Rules: Grama Niladhari Division Search (Interactive Triage) **Service Name**: Find Grama Niladhari Division **Service ID**: gn_division_lookup **Category**: Regional Administration **Office Type**: Divisional Secretariat region **Official Fee**: Free of charge ## Description Guidelines on how to locate or verify your local Grama Niladhari (GN) division name or number. ## GN Division Lookup Guidance If a citizen does not know their Grama Niladhari (GN) division: 1. **Interactive Resolution**: Request the citizen's exact village name, municipal ward, or street name. 2. **GN Lookup Map**: Use the regional gazette or Divisional Secretariat's village-to-division mapping directory to find the division code. 3. **GN Office**: The local Divisional Secretariat has an administrative officer at the **GN Administration Desk (Room 2)** who can verify the division name based on the village address.
